Make it Festive: Corn & Cheese Parcels

Crispy, flaky and filled with the creamiest cheese and corn filling, these little parcels are exactly what you want on a festive table. They’re ridiculously easy to put together, can be prepped ahead, and are perfect for passing around while everyone’s busy chatting, eating and celebrating. Serve them warm with your favourite dip and watch them disappear!

Ingredients

* ½ cup cream cheese
* ¾ cup sweet corn, boiled
* 2 tbsp spring onion, finely chopped
* ½ tsp chilli flakes
* ½ tsp dried oregano
* Salt, to taste
* ½ tsp black pepper
* 1 sheet puff pastry
* Oil, for spraying

Method

1. In a bowl, add cream cheese, sweet corn, spring onion, chilli flakes, oregano, salt and pepper. Mix well.
2. Cut the puff pastry into squares and place a spoonful of the filling in the centre.
3. Fold and seal the pastry into neat little parcels.
4. Lightly spray with oil.
5. Cook in a preheated oven or air fryer at 180°C for 10–15 minutes, or until golden and crisp.
6. Serve warm with your favourite dip.
